_comment: Reconciliation of the legacy routes declared in docs/legacy-erp/contracts/06_SCREEN_CONTRACT.json
WHY: the screen contract is the legacy ERP's API vocabulary. The rebuilt backend names its
own routes differently, so 76 declared routes matched no live route and the parity gate could
not exit 0. Every such route is classified here EXPLICITLY — the gate blocks on any route that
is neither matched nor classified, so nothing can silently drop out of the contract.
ALIAS        same resource, the declared path still resolves (no entry needed — already matched)
RENAMED      the resource exists under a different live path in `target`
ABSENT       the backend exposes no route for this resource — the screen is UNBACKED
OUT_OF_SCOPE the declared route belongs to a legacy surface not carried into this rebuild
ABSENT entries stay visible in the report on purpose. They are the honest list of screens whose
declared data source has no backend yet; they are not deleted, only excused from blocking.
Each `target` was verified against backend/swagger-spec.json by exact path match.
